release_plan.BRONZE_SCOPE_PASS_98: only measured active dataset market period with both >=98%, source context, and no unisolated hard stop
release_plan.PARTIAL: release unaffected subscopes; missing dates/fields/indicators masked and repair queue persists
release_plan.QUARANTINE: damaged files, wrong security/date/market, PIT-sensitive unsafe derived signals
release_plan.UNKNOWN: contract/calendar or inspection denominator not established; do not call it complete, don't block unrelated scopes
release_plan.SILVER: convert PASS_98 subscopes; source-original format unchanged; no global 443 dependency gate
release_plan.GOLD: activate only indicators whose validated sources/warmup/release dates are available

migration_versus_quality: Validated v093->v095 original bytes are not proof every dataset was ever downloaded; keep these measurements separate
